name: Circeo
shape: ARSIAL wine zones for Regione Lazio
terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: A Lazio denomination limited to four communes: Latina, Sabaudia, San Felice Circeo and Terracina. Its rules allow still, semi-sparkling and sparkling wine.
